subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub retire the standalone CLI GitHub Release repair workflow, or keep/replace it with an equivalent post-publish recovery path before this PR can merge?
rationale: Source, docs, and tests show the deleted workflow is the approved recovery path after npm publish succeeds, and the PR does not include an equivalent replacement.

options.title: Replace Before Deletion
options.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow path that still works after npm has accepted the package, then update the runbook and tests.

options.title: Keep Existing Workflow
options.body: Leave the standalone workflow and runbook in place until release owners decide the repair path is unnecessary.

options.title: Retire With Owner Acceptance
options.body: Accept the operational risk only if release/secops owners document the new recovery procedure and reconcile the tests.

recommendation.title: Replace Before Deletion
recommendation.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow path that still works after npm has accepted the package, then update the runbook and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes workflow and deploy-runbook ownership to this team.
